Rice Crop Manager (RCM)
Rice Crop Manager (RCM) is a web-based tool based on the Site-Specif ic Nut rient Management (SSNM) approach. It gives rice farmers recommendat ions for applying the right amount of essent ial nut rients for their crops at the right t ime, along with weed and nursery management recommendat ions.
A farmer applying fertilizer as per RCM recommendations in his plot

How to use RCM?
Farmers are interviewed using a standard set of quest ions in the RCM applicat ion on a mobile phone or com p u t er
Their responses are captured to generate fert ilizer recommendat ions for their specif ic plot . This includes the amount and t ime of applicat ion of various fert ilizers
Recommendat ion is printed on an A4 size paper and provided to the farmers to be used throughout the season
The ent ire recommendat ion is also sent to the farmers during the season at the t ime of fert ilizer applicat ion through SMSs and voice calls through IFFCO-Kisan and Precision Agriculture for Development (PAD )

Who can use RCM?
- Farmers
- Extension workers
- Researchers
- Agro-advisory providers
- St udent s
It will help adjust the fert ilizer rate to match the planned target yield and for the specif ic variety being used
It helps cont rol weeds in the rice crop by providing recommendat ions to manage weeds It gives the exact amount of fert ilizer needed and the right t im ing for applicat ion for the specif ic plot and helps avoid excessive u sag e As a result of the above it helps save fert ilizer costs reducing the costs of product ion, improving yield and consequent ly increasing the net returns to the farm er
